asset.name: Eastman Eagle S3L
asset.description: Eastman Eagle S3L automated laser cutting system documented by service form E-554.

expected_claims.symptom: Machine stops in middle of cut and displays Machine Paused
expected_claims.failure_mode: intermittent pause circuit, usually in the stop discs
expected_claims.corrective_action: adjust the pause plunger activation pressure

expected_claims.symptom: Touch Screen buttons are out of alignment
expected_claims.failure_mode: Touch screen calibration is required
expected_claims.corrective_action: complete touch screen calibration and save and exit

expected_claims.symptom: Cutting Tool or Pen does not move down
expected_claims.failure_mode: tool or layer is not mapped properly
expected_claims.corrective_action: map the tool to the spindle or the layer to the tool

expected_claims.symptom: Laser Fume Extractor has reduced vacuum or no vacuum
expected_claims.failure_mode: vacuum filters require replacement
expected_claims.annotation_note: The association is conveyed by the Problem/Troubleshooting layout rather than a standalone causal sentence.

expected_claims.symptom: Laser cutting path is too wide
expected_claims.failure_mode: brass laser nozzle is damaged or bent

expected_claims.symptom: Loss of laser cutting power causing non-cut edges
expected_claims.failure_mode: focusing lens is damaged or dirty

expected_claims.symptom: Loss of laser cutting power causing non-cut edges
expected_claims.failure_mode: beam deflecting mirror is damaged or dirty

expected_claims.symptom: Loss of laser cutting power causing non-cut edges
expected_claims.failure_mode: laser nozzle contains damage or debris
expected_claims.corrective_action: clean or replace the laser nozzle
